name: Sour Tangie Cartridge | 1g
description: Bright and punchy, Sour Tangie delivers a sharp citrus kick with a touch of funky fuel. It’s the kind of strain that clears the cobwebs and hits the gas — perfect for a morning cruise or mid-afternoon mood boost.
